ratings.comment: Definitely one of the most incredible professors at UW. Her background makes for a really unique perspective on policy-making, and it's nice to hear about in some lectures. You definitely have to apply yourself and put effort into writing assignments, but you'll grow throughout the course, and that is taken into account for grading.

Eileen is one of the best professors I have ever had. I would definitely recommend this class and her to anyone who can take it. It is definitely writing heavy, but she is always open to help students.

One of the best classes I've taken at UW. Professor Harrington is one of the most knowledgeable professors, and is very passionate about the subject matter. She's also very understanding of her students, and is very approachable. I wish I could take another class with her!

I would argue that she is the best lecturer I've ever had.  She regularly makes time to meet outside of class.  She's just so interesting to talk to because of her extensive background in Washington as the Executive Director of the FTC

She used to work for the FTC. Knows public policy inside and out. Three policy memos on subjects she assigns. Gives you a clear rubric, but they are still difficult. Her personal stories about policy making over her career are great. Lectures can get boring. Don't need to take notes. Attendance mandatory.

Great professor, used to work at the FTC so she has amazing experiences. Teaches because she wants to expose students to public policy. Lectures are good, a mix of class participation and storytelling and some summary of the readings. Expect to work hard on the papers! Even if you're a great writer, you'll have to spend time researching.
